Dear Luca Rizzi,

out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey

Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R9 170002556
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
RN4SQN
Problem Description
:
Authorization Issue
Troubleshooting
: We have analyzed the logs and found that every time the cable check charging phase is started, there is an error related to the contactor QA13-14 (FBK Timeout) due to the coil of the contactor being stuck. In this case, you will need to replace the contactors and then attempt charging again. Below is the snapshot, and the time is in UTC. I am handing over the case to your queue for parts ordering and the replacement activity. Attached are the charging logs also for your reference.
MLFB : 8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8 (Contactor DC 2P 500A 1200VDC)
For future reference, your case number is
0404641
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
